parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello. Thank you for calling Iris Rentals. How can I help you?

Yes, hello there. I'm ringing just to make inquiries about renting a new property. And I came across a listing on your website that I'm interested in.

Oh, yes.

I'd like to find out a few more details if I may.

Yes, of course. Can I take your name?

It's Mary Collins.

Okay, Mary. I'm just searching our system for the property details. Is there any information in particular that you were wanting?

Does the house have a gym?

No, the house doesn't have a gym. However, the house has a large swimming pool, which will be great for exercise and really refreshing during the summer.

Oh, wow. That sounds lovely. What is the general layout of the house?

The house is rather unusual as the living room is located upstairs with the bedrooms and downstairs at the ground floor is the dining room, which has a lovely view out over the swimming pool.

Does the house come with a car parking space on the street?

Oh, there's no need for that. The house comes with a big garage where you can park your cars and there's also a lot of room for storage. It's attached to the house through a door in the kitchen.

Oh, that's perfect. It'll make it far easier to carry my food shopping into the house.

Oh, yes. Absolutely. You actually don't even need to take your car to do the shopping as the local supermarket is just down the street. You can walk the distance easily.

Really? How convenient. Is there anywhere near to the house where I can take my children to play?

Unfortunately, there aren't any playgrounds nearby, but there is a park near the supermarket that would be great for taking your children for a walk. It would also be a great place for you to meet your neighbours.

Yes, that's true. I love taking long walks in the park. I'm sure there will be a playground at the local school anyway.

Yes, absolutely. The community has its own primary school and there is a secondary school in the neighbouring community, so there are plenty of resources nearby for your children's education.

Okay, great. What are the rental costs for the property?

The monthly rent is $980, which is very reasonable considering the size of the house and the amenities that it has to offer.

Does that figure include maintenance fees and bills?

The bills are not included in that figure, but it does include any maintenance fees for the garden.

That sounds like a very reasonable price. We were hoping to move on the 20th of April. Will the house be vacant for that date?

The current tenants of the property are due to leave on the 20th, but the cleaners will need a few days to make sure that the house is clean and tidy. This would make the house officially available on the 23rd of April.

Well, everything about the house sounds perfect, exactly what I'm looking for. What date would it be possible to view the property?

I have arranged for the tenant to leave the property on Friday, so I can show the house to prospective renters. Would you be able to make that date?

Yes, I'm sure I could come on my lunch break. Would one o'clock be okay?

I'm afraid that I have a meeting at 12.30, so I won't be able to make that time. I have available appointments at 10.15 and 3.

Okay, in that case, can we schedule the appointment for 10.15?

No problem, I'll book it into my schedule. If you wouldn't mind arriving five minutes early, that would be great, just so we can get started on time.

Sure, what is the address?

The postcode is GA5 8ER, and the house is number 8 on Spring Street. It's the second right off of Bath Street.

Okay, that's great.

Do you have any more questions?

Nope, thank you for your help.

No problem, see you on Friday.bye.

analyses.content: 中介明确表示房子没有健身房，但是有一个很大的 swimming pool（游泳池）。
No, the house doesn't have a gym. However, the house has a large swimming pool, which will be great for exercise and really refreshing during the summer.
不要听到 "gym" 就填，录音说 "No, the house doesn't have a gym"，这是典型的否定陷阱。
The house is rather unusual as the living room is located upstairs with the bedrooms and downstairs at the ground floor is the dining room, which has a lovely view out over the swimming pool.
注意听方位的转换，Living room 和 Bedrooms 都在楼上（upstairs），不要填错位置。
介绍房屋布局时，中介说楼下（downstairs）是 dining room（餐厅），且能看到泳池风景。
Oh, there's no need for that. The house comes with a big garage where you can park your cars and there's also a lot of room for storage.
不要填 "car parking space"，题目问的是 "availability of a large..."，你需要填那个具体的设施名称 garage。
中介说不需要路边停车，因为房子自带一个大 garage（车库）可以停车。
You actually don't even need to take your car to do the shopping as the local supermarket is just down the street.
题目允许写两个词，建议把 "local" 带上以确保信息完整，直接填 "supermarket" 也是核心词。
购物很方便，不需要开车，因为 local supermarket（当地超市）就在街尾。
Unfortunately, there aren't any playgrounds nearby, but there is a park near the supermarket that would be great for taking your children for a walk.
不要填 "playground"，录音明确说 "Unfortunately, there aren't any playgrounds nearby"（不幸的是附近没有操场）。
虽然附近没有操场，但中介推荐了超市附近的一个 park（公园），适合带孩子散步。
关于教育资源，社区拥有自己的 primary school（小学）。
The community has its own primary school and there is a secondary school in the neighbouring community...
不要填 "secondary school"，那是位于相邻社区（neighboring community）的，不是本社区的资源。
The bills are not included in that figure, but it does include any maintenance fees for the garden.
题目问的是 "maintenance fees of the..."，不要填 bills，录音说 bills are not included。
房租虽然不包账单，但确实包含了 garden（花园）的维护费。
The current tenants of the property are due to leave on the 20th, but... This would make the house officially available on the 23rd of April.
不要听到 "20th" 就填，那是前租客离开的日子，还没打扫完，不能住人。
虽然租客20号搬走，但需要几天清洁，所以房子正式可用的日期是 23rd of April。
因为中介12:30有会，不能约1点，双方最终商定在 10:15 见面看房。
不需要填 am，因为录音中确实没有明确提到是上午还是下午。
I'm afraid that I have a meeting at 12.30... I have available appointments at 10.15 and 3. Okay, in that case, can we schedule the appointment for 10.15?
The postcode is GA5 8ER, and the house is number 8 on Spring Street. It's the second right off of Bath Street.
不要填 "Bath Street"，那是拐进来的路口（off of Bath Street），不是房子所在的街道。
中介给出了详细地址，房子位于 Spring Street（春季街/斯普林街）8号。
